sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The last warded marker slips behind you. Ahead, the road narrows and the old forest closes around the carriage.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Cross from the contract briefing into the forest road. The next thing ahead blocks the path.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: The carriage crosses from city-controlled road into a vast ancient forest and hands off to Act One.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Ask one player what comforting lie a corporate sign tells travelers. Use their answer later as irony.
Keep player-facing information actionable. Reveal systemic truth through objects, reactions, and consequences before naming it.
Manufactured-threat lens: seed the contradiction, do not explain it. The surface goal stays simple and heroic.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: The last warded marker slips behind you. The road narrows, the city noise thins, and the forest rises around the carriage like a green wall. Who has the reins, and what is the first strange detail your character notices about these trees?
